title: Rav Ada bar Avimi
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: (An Amora in the Land of Israel, of the fourth generation.) He was a student of Rabbi Chanina (a colleague of the Rabbis): Eruvin 9b has him reciting before him, and 12a has the alternative “before Rabbi Chanina bar Papi.” Yuchasin read Abba bar Avimi; Rashi on 14b, under mishum, has Ada bar Menyumi. He was also Rabbi Zeira’s student, and Rabbi Chizkiyah and Rabbi Nachum were his colleagues, as at the end of Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 9:2. Taanit 1:3 there reads bar Ivuma; Hyman proposes bar Avimi.

notes.text: חברון דרבנן describes Chanina as a colleague of the Rabbis; it does not identify a Hebron rabbinic circle. Ada/Abba, Avimi/Ivuma and Menyumi remain Hyman’s reported variants.

The consulted Eruvin 9b and 12a read Ada bar Avimi, with Chanina or the alternative Chanina bar Pappi. Rashi on Eruvin 14b, mishum, reads Ada bar Menyumi. Hyman’s Yuchasin form Abba and his Ivuma-to-Avimi correction remain separate attributed reports.
